summary:
Extended `plugins-hardcoded-cn.mjs` (never rewritten — the language gate, `HOOKS` fallback, `preventIndent` compile, and dual-sentinel notify shim are all preserved) from 3 empty tables to 5 wired channels covering motion-tracker-multideck 1.0.2 and the terminal 4.0.11 player-facing slice.

**Channels shipped**
- **A (new here) — flat top-level i18n keys, 13 entries.** Re-derived that these two plugins having no i18n plumbing does *not* mean they are unreachable: core itself localizes them. appv1 `get title() { return _loc(this.options.title) }` (application-v1.mjs:327) covers the multideck window title; `config.mjs:59-66` + `config-category.hbs:4/10/14` `{{localize}}` covers registerMenu name/label/hint; `config.mjs:126-127` `_loc(setting.name/hint)` covers terminal's 3 `config:true` settings; `notifications.mjs:121` `_loc` is unconditional, which covers multideck's 4 *static* notifications. So no shim is needed for any of those — this follows the sister patcher's existing doctrine rather than inventing a mechanism.
- **B — partial pre-registration** for `modules/motion-tracker-multideck/templates/link-manager.hbs`. Changed the table's value shape from inline source to *our file path* + fetch, matching `alienrpg-hardcoded-cn.mjs`, so the translated .hbs is a real file the D-group can diff against the English baseline.
- **C — notification shim, now regex-based** for the 4 template-string (`${}`) notifications; each anchored `^…$` with the tightest possible interpolation classes (`[AB]`, `\d+`, signed decimals). Exported `translatePluginNotification()` so QA tests shipping code.
- **D (new) — terminal's 4 fixed button labels** via `renderTerminal` + a `MutationObserver` on `.terminal-folders` (childList only, no subtree).
- **E (new) — terminal's 9 ASCII `<h1>` headings** by dynamic-importing the same absolute URL as terminal.js's own `import { ASCII } from "./presets.js"` and mutating only the `<h1>` text. The braille/ASCII art is provably untouched.

**Three measurement corrections to the task brief (source beats brief):** multideck has 8 notifications, not 9; it has 1 settings register (and it is `config:false`, so per the F5 doctrine it must *not* be translated — fused instead), not 2; and terminal's scramble affects 28/28 shipped styles, not 20/28.

Both QA suites green: adversarial 300 PASS / 0 FAIL (125 pre-existing + 175 new), positive suite 115 PASS / 0 FAIL.

files_written.what: Extended in place from 209 to ~660 lines. Added channel A (LITERAL_LABELS, 13 keys with per-key `requires` module gating and yield-to-others-on-collision), channel C patterns (NOTIFICATION_PATTERNS + exported translatePluginNotification), channel D (TERMINAL_BUTTON_LABELS + relabelTerminalButtons + renderTerminal/closeTerminal observer), channel E (TERMINAL_ASCII_HEADINGS + exported pure translateAsciiHeading + translateTerminalAscii). Changed TEMPLATE_OVERRIDES from inline-source to file-path + fetch to match the sister patcher. Every pre-existing QA-asserted string kept verbatim.

Translated multideck Scene Links window: 29 visible text strings + 3 title=/placeholder= attributes. Tag skeleton is byte-for-byte identical to the English baseline (137 tags), and the non-comment handlebars expression sequence is identical too. Zero residual visible English.
English baseline snapshot of the upstream template, byte-identical to the installed 1.0.2 file (sha256 b6f3b143…).
Drift pins for the plugin template, same schema as alienrpg-4.1.13's: upstream/baseline/ours sha256, skeleton sha256 + tag count, baseline visible-English count, baseline attribute strings.

Added groups N6-N10, M2, D2, F6-F10 (75 new check() call sites, 175 executed checks). Includes cross-package resolution-point allowlists, lang-JSON collision scan, 17 notification near-miss cases, 7 relabel near-miss cases against a fake DOM, 5 channel-E near-miss cases, and the real upstream presets.js imported so the art-preservation checks run against real data.

decisions.decision: CJK bug (a) padEnd: keep those cells English, do NOT ship an East-Asian-width padder
decisions.reason: Two hard reasons, both fused in QA. (1) Unreachable: generateTable is a local `function` declaration inside initCLI's body — not exported, not on any object, no assignment form. The only way to reach it would be wrapping String.prototype.padEnd, which is a global surgery with unacceptable blast radius. (2) Unnecessary: zero of the 16 strings this pass translates flows into it — its 6 call sites take the English help table and world data (actor/journal/file names). QA asserts the function is still closure-local, still uses String.length+padEnd, that none of our Chinese strings appears at any call site, and that the call sites still exist (so the check isn't vacuous).

decisions.decision: CJK bug (b) scrambleText: keep the Chinese headings, and defuse the scramble using upstream's own guard by wrapping the h1 text in a <span>
decisions.reason:
The two options offered were both unavailable or bad. A CJK chars pool is impossible: `chars: "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz "` is a literal inside a closure in terminal.js, and patching gsap's ScrambleTextPlugin would hit every gsap consumer (dice-so-nice et al.). Leaving the 9 headings English is worse UX than jitter, because the 4 buttons that trigger them ARE translated — a Chinese button popping an English banner. Third path: terminal.js:852-856 only adds .terminal-typewriter when `node.children.length === 0`, so `

地图已下载

` opts out of the scramble timeline for exactly our 9 strings and nothing else. Cost, stated plainly: those 9 headings no longer animate (on all 28 styles, since all 28 enable it); terminal's scramble everywhere else is untouched. QA fuses the guard, the chars pool, the fact that .terminal-typewriter has only 2 consumers, and that our shipped output really contains the span.

decisions.decision: Route multideck's window title, menu, and 4 static notifications through channel A (top-level i18n keys) rather than a lang file or a notify shim
decisions.reason: The survey's "a lang file is useless" is right about the plugin's OWN keys but does not mean the plugin is unreachable — core localizes appv1 titles, settings menu fields, and every notify() message unconditionally. This follows the sister patcher's already-established doctrine (static literals -> channel A, ${} strings -> shim) instead of inventing a second mechanism, and it keeps the notify wrapper carrying only 4 regexes. These keys cannot live in lang/cn.json because #loadTranslationFile expandObject()s every lang JSON and would split the dotted sentences into nested keys.

decisions.decision: Do NOT translate multideck's "Scene Links" setting name/hint
decisions.reason: That register call is config:false, so it never renders in the settings panel — translating it would be a write with no reader, and it would put a very generic 2-word string into the global i18n table for nothing. Follows the sister file's existing F5 doctrine. Replaced with a fuse that trips if it ever becomes config:true.

decisions.decision: Changed TEMPLATE_OVERRIDES from {path: inline source} to {upstream path: our file path} + fetch
decisions.reason: The only structural change to pre-existing code, and it was required by the task's own instruction to put the .hbs under templates/multideck/. It also makes the translation diffable against the English baseline by the D group (skeleton + handlebars-expression comparison), which an inline string cannot be. Now identical in shape to alienrpg-hardcoded-cn.mjs.

decisions.decision: Channel D uses a MutationObserver on .terminal-folders rather than a one-shot sweep at render
decisions.reason: terminal.js:150 `static password()` calls createHTML() only AFTER the password is accepted — i.e. after renderTerminal has already fired. A one-shot sweep would silently translate nothing on every password-protected terminal. Scoped to childList (no subtree) on .terminal-folders because all 4 buttons are direct children there, while the high-frequency CLI typing churn happens in .terminal-history/.terminal-textbox.

decisions.decision: Anchored channel D on .terminal-folders, explicitly NOT .terminal-window
decisions.reason: Measured: .terminal-window has two holders in this world — modules/terminal and modules/alien-mu-th-ur. .terminal-folders and the 4 button classes have exactly one. QA now asserts both the safe anchors' exclusivity AND that terminal-window is shared (so the reason survives as a fact, not a memory), plus that our source never uses it as an anchor.

decisions.decision: Channel E mutates the exported ASCII object via dynamic import instead of patching the DOM
decisions.reason: Working upstream of the DOM means the translation is in place before enrichHTML/parse/postMount ever see it, which is also what makes the <span> opt-out possible. URL identity verified from core: main.hbs:28 emits esmodule src as a relative path resolved against {prefix}/game, which is byte-identical to foundry.utils.getRoute('modules/terminal/scripts/presets.js') — same module record, same object reference, so mutating ASCII.ATLAS is what terminal.js reads at click time.

decisions.decision: Kept the 3 styleMenu strings (🎨 Styles / Edit Styles / hint) untranslated
decisions.reason: Task scoped this pass to the player-facing slice; the style editor is a GM-only authoring tool. Their conflict surface measured 0, so they are safe to add later. Rather than silently skipping them, a fuse records that they still exist, are still English, and are deliberately absent from LITERAL_LABELS.

open_issues: NOT VERIFIED AT RUNTIME. No Foundry was launched. Three things need a live smoke test on the VPS: (1) the dynamic import of presets.js really returns the same module instance terminal.js holds — the URL-identity argument is derived from core source (main.hbs:28 + getRoute) but not observed; (2) renderTerminal really fires after the buttons exist (derived from _doEvent's async .then branch); (3) the multideck partial pre-registration actually wins over getTemplate.

Cross-client language bleed, unavoidable without forking terminal: showContent (terminal.js:246-262) broadcasts the RENDERED injectObj (ASCII.X and div.textContent, both translated) over the socket to shadow views and the GM approval flow. A Chinese player's click will therefore put Chinese into an English GM's shadow view. The language gate is per-client; the module broadcasts content rather than keys. Documented in the patch file.

The padEnd border-raggedness WILL bite this project through world data, not through this patch: `ls` renders the FILENAME column from .terminal-journal-page textContent, i.e. journal page names — which this project translates to Chinese in the compendia. Borders will skew for any GM who points a Terminal at translated journals. Upstream defect amplified by our translations; unreachable without forking (QA fuses it).

terminal styleMenu (🎨 Styles / Edit Styles / 'Create custom styling for your terminals') deliberately left English — GM authoring tool, outside the player-facing slice. Conflict surface measured 0, so it is a clean 3-key addition whenever the GM surface gets its pass.

terminal config.hbs (26354 chars of GM configuration prose injected into the Tile config sheet) untranslated by instruction, plus the remaining terminal strings outside this slice: dynamic button defaults ('Run Script', `Alter Door Lock ${n}`, `Secure Shell ${n}`, 'PERSONAL TERMINAL'), the CLI help table, skillCheck's 'Permission Denied' block, and terminal's own ui.notifications (e.g. '❌ Incorrect login', 'Skipping skill check, since you're a GM').

module.json's description still lists only the four plugins that get lang files; it now also runtime-patches terminal and motion-tracker-multideck. Left unedited on purpose — a sibling agent is working on lang/plugins/*.json and may touch the same manifest. One-line fix when that lands.
MU-TH-UR's MUTHUR_GLOBAL_SEQUENCES table is still empty — untouched, it belongs to a different work item.

The multideck translation coins terms not yet in glossary_alien.json: 多层甲板配套模块 (Multideck Companion), 对位点 (matching point), 场景链接 (Scene link), 信号点 (blip). Only Motion Tracker=运动追踪器 and Power=电力 came from the authorities. If these words later appear in core-book prose they will be translated independently with nothing flagging the divergence — same blind spot the QA's G group documents for planet-general.hbs. Worth folding these four into the glossary.
